## Scope

Describe the bounded component and user-visible change.

## Evidence

- [ ] I ran the component tests that would fail without this change.
- [ ] I ran the root regression required by the component's gate.
- [ ] I tested rendered behaviour when the change affects an interface.
- [ ] I updated status, evidence, README and changelog files where applicable.

## Safety and release state

- [ ] No token, customer data, private content or local path is included.
- [ ] Unsupported and unavailable states remain explicit.
- [ ] A passing check is not described as proof of human authorship.
- [ ] No held provider, model, corpus, deployment or publication action is bundled into this change.
